name: Parabolic Root-Finding with Gradients
definition: A root-finding technique that estimates the zero-crossing of a scalar field F(x) along a line segment by fitting a parabola to the function values and gradients at the endpoints, avoiding an extra function evaluation.
summary: Parabolic Root-Finding with Gradients estimates zero-crossings by fitting a parabola to endpoint values and gradients, offering higher accuracy than the secant method without extra function evaluations.
